sample_unit: patients (part 1: 1298 pre-AI, 1107 post-AI; part 2: 43 control, 88 AI)

links.outcome: Mean MV time, ICU LOS, and hospital LOS with vs without AI-assisted weaning in COVID-19 ICU
links.effect: With AI (n=88) vs control (n=43): MV time 244.2 vs 426.0 hours (P=.011), ICU LOS 11.0 vs 18.7 days (P=.001), hospital LOS 23.5 vs 40.4 days (P<.001).
links.quote: In the second part of the study, the intervention group (with AI, n = 88) exhibited a shorter mean MV time (244.2 hours vs 426.0 hours, P = .011), ICU LOS (11.0 days vs 18.7 days, P = .001), and hospital LOS (23.5 days vs 40.4 days, P < .001) compared to the control group (without AI, n = 43).

unlisted_practices: Interdisciplinary team integration of AI prediction into ventilator weaning protocol

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical impact of deploying an AI-assisted mechanical ventilation weaning protocol in medical and COVID-19 ICUs compared to care without AI.
